11861|2ff59fb5.name: Mor'rogal
11861|2ff59fb5.text:
Stonetalon Mountain has many perilous caves through out this region.  Exploring these caves can hold many adventures for those willing to risk life for glory.

$C, perhaps you seek riches that only following your heart and soul can garnish.

248202|055d4e51.name: Jim'bek
248202|055d4e51.text:
<Jim'bek locks eyes with you as he takes a deep puff from his hookah.>

'Ello, mon. Need a rug? A blanket? Or just some cloth for your next project? I got you.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3484|e50c189b.name: Kil'hala
3484|e50c189b.text: At dis point you know as much as I do, mon. Maybe you go see Magar in Orgrimmar. He not be da happiest tailor around, but he help you anyway.

5883|8fca8484.name: Enyo
5883|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

7731|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

1087-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-accept.text:
You cannot imagine the hatred I possess for this wretched land. The ilk of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak employ their pathetic powers to stifle the flow of magic, even so far south of their pathetic holdings... their beloved forests.

Would that I could return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic, but my master will not allow me to return until my work is done.

I have no doubt you love the night elves and their allies as little as I. Aid me, and both our ends might be satisfied.
1087-accept.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1486-accept.name: Nalpak
1486-accept.text:
As Naralex descended deeper into his nightmare, a strange breed of beasts arose from beneath the Barrens into the Wailing Caverns.

These deviate creatures have strange, otherworldly properties. While evil in nature, it is my opinion that some good can come from their existence here in Kalimdor. I believe their hides will be of particular use in the ways of leatherworking.

If you feel up to the task, venture into the caves below and retrieve some deviate hides.
1486-accept.title: Deviate Hides

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

1487-accept.name: Ebru
1487-accept.text:
Naralex had a noble goal.

Our great leader aspired to enter the Emerald Dream and help regrow these harsh lands back into the lush forest it once was. But something went terribly wrong.

Naralex's dream turned into a nightmare and corrupt creatures began to inhabit the caverns.

While some Disciples of Naralex seek to awake our master, my concern is with ridding these caves of the evil beasts.

Brave the caverns, $N, and eradicate the deviate spawn.
1487-accept.title: Deviate Eradication

1492-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
1492-progress.text: You seek passage on the next ship, or have some item you wish to send aboard it?
1492-progress.title: Wharfmaster Dizzywig

1525-progress.name: Telf Joolam
1525-progress.text:
I have enough ingredients for a sapta of fire if you can find the reagent pouch and some fire tar. The Burning Blade fanatics carry the proper components for most of their spells in those pouches, and usually have enough of the items I need that we will not have to search much farther for anything else.

The saptas are always made from ingredients that are closely tied to their respective elements. It makes our work easier because of the warlocks' ties to fire.
1525-progress.title: Call of Fire

1526-progress.name: Brazier of the Dormant Flame
1526-progress.text: The brazier stands about a third your height, and looks normal, save for the inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch.
1526-progress.title: Call of Fire

1527-progress.name: Kranal Fiss
1527-progress.text: Yes, $N? What do you have there?
1527-progress.title: Call of Fire

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

3921-progress.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3921-progress.text: I'm very busy with my work, $c.  Unless you have something for me, it'd be best if you moved along...
3921-progress.title: Wenikee Boltbucket

446-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
446-progress.text: Greetings, $N.  What did Bethor have to say?
446-progress.title: Thule Ravenclaw

5041-progress.name: Thork
5041-progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
5041-progress.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

6301-accept.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-accept.text:
Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.

$N, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.

Once you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.
6301-accept.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6386-complete.name: Zargh
6386-complete.text:
Hah!  I guess she liked it!  Nothing brings red to a lady's cheeks like a big, juicy steak!

Thank you, $N.  You've done me a great service.  Here is some money for your trouble, and don't be surprised if I invite you to my wedding!
6386-complete.title: Return to the Crossroads

6386-progress.name: Zargh
6386-progress.text: Have you returned from Orgrimmar?  Did Gryshka like the meat I sent her?
6386-progress.title: Return to the Crossroads

6393-accept.name: Tsunaman
6393-accept.text:
The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.

$N, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.
6393-accept.title: Elemental War

6421-accept.name: Mor'rogal
6421-accept.text:
Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, $N?

Southeast of here lies a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave.  I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.

Go young $c, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.
6421-accept.title: Boulderslide Ravine

6461-accept.name: Xen'Zilla
6461-accept.text:
We Trolls here at Malaka'Jin have prospered from the land; Stonetalon Mountain offers great hunting for us to live on.

Lately, we have attracted the wrong dinner guests... the spiders in these mountains have been raiding our camps at night looking to steal our hunt.

If you were to help us kill off these ghastly beasts we at Malaka'Jin would be in your debt. Spiders are everywhere in Stonetalon - just head north from here and you will see what I am talking about.
6461-accept.title: Blood Feeders

6562-accept.name: Tsunaman
6562-accept.text: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, $N. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.
6562-accept.title: Trouble in the Deeps

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

7833-progress.name: Vehena
7833-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Darkspear Trolls for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7833-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

844-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-progress.text: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
844-progress.title: Plainstrider Menace

848-progress.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-progress.text: Do you have the spores, $N?  There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
848-progress.title: Fungal Spores

865-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-accept.text:
The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands.  And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns!  If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks."  I could sell them for a fortune!!!

And you can help me.  Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws.  They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.
865-accept.title: Raptor Horns

872-progress.name: Thork
872-progress.text:
Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, $N. Learn this lesson well. It will aid you in the future.

The boars will flounder without direction, and we will be able to take back the Barrens.
872-progress.title: The Disruption Ends

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-progress.text: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
890-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

892-progress.name: Gazlowe
892-progress.text: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
892-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

901-progress.name: Control Console
901-progress.text: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
901-progress.title: Samophlange

902-progress.name: Sputtervalve
902-progress.text: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
902-progress.title: Samophlange

914-progress.name: Nara Wildmane
914-progress.text: Memories of my nightmares haunt me, $N.  Have you defeated the leaders of the fang and acquired their gems?
914-progress.title: Leaders of the Fang

92706-accept.name: Unknown
92706-accept.text:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe
92706-accept.title: WANTED: Bruuz

962-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-progress.text: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962-progress.title: Serpentbloom

97253-accept.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-accept.text:
Hey, got a sec?

So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!

I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?
97253-accept.title: Parts and Pieces
